modelingNotes: Exact Weidmüller order 1211300000, HDC HE 24 FS, female insert, installation size 8. The manufacturer customer drawing marks contacts 1-12 in one row and 13-24 in the other, and identifies BOM item 3 as PE CONTACT (nickel-plated brass). The source table contains 24 power contacts and zero separate signal contacts. No phase, supply polarity or application net is assigned.

C.1-C.24 and M.1-M.24 are authoring aliases separating each fixed contact conductor into its cable screw termination and female mating endpoint. The numbers are manufacturer identities from the exact drawing. The C/M prefixes and terminalOrder are logical conventions; neither adds a manufacturer side marking nor an installed orientation.

Represent the 24 fixed contact conductors by explicit project jumpers C.n-M.n for n=1 through 24, justified by the exact fixed-contact insert drawing and its termination/contactor views. These are factory-path representations, not field-installed jumpers. No numbered pole connects to any other pole or to PE. Singleton bus functions and connector metadata never join nets.

PE is a single aggregate node for the verified PE contact assembly. The drawing identifies a PE assembly and end hardware, while the exact sheet explicitly specifies a PE screw connection. This model does not invent C.PE/M.PE, numbered left/right PE screws, a link between separately invented PE endpoints, or a bond to an enclosing hood. Individual PE interfaces remain unenumerated: connectionCoverage is partial.

The aggregate PE endpoint is required by this library policy for the connector's modeled protective-earth use. This policy is not attributed to a manufacturer instruction for every possible application. Numbered passive contacts remain application-dependent. Projects may annotate deliberate non-use and must establish actual external protective bonding; presence of PE does not prove upstream bonding.

Exact manufacturer sheet https://datasheet.weidmueller.com/pdf/en/1211300000/scope/2/, creation 18.02.2026 09:06:33 MEZ, pp.1-4: DIN EN 61984 rating 500 V / 16 A, impulse 6 kV, pollution severity 3, insulating group IIIa; UL/CSA voltage 600 V AC/DC. Current depends on approval and wire size: UR at AWG12/14/16/18/20 is 20/15/10/7/5 A; cUR is 19.7/15/11.3/10.3/8 A. These tables are not flattened into an unconditional terminal rating or assigned supply voltage.

Exact sheet pp.2-4: limiting temperature -40 to +125 degC is a component limit, not evidence for full rated current at every ambient temperature. Main termination: 0.5-2.5 mm2 solid or finely stranded, ferruled maximum 2.5 mm2, listed AWG20-14, M3, 9 mm strip. The approval tables also list AWG12; that mismatch does not authorize exceeding the stated termination range. PE: M4, rated cross-section 4 mm2, AWG20-12, 10 mm strip, 1.2-1.5 Nm. Contacts are copper alloy with silver-passivated surface; the drawing describes silver-plated brass contactors.

Torque revision discrepancy remains application-critical: 2026 exact sheet gives main-contact 0.6-0.7 Nm; manufacturer HDC tightening-torque table https://assets.dam.weidmueller.com/assets/api/719442ee-190c-4c27-8b06-0fb4d3eaf6d9/original/HDC_Tightening_torques.pdf, 1460950000 / 2014/2015, p.A.17, gives HE M3 0.5-0.55 Nm. Both give HE M4 PE 1.2-1.5 Nm. Confirm the installed revision/manufacturer instruction before tightening; this model selects no universal main-contact torque.

No additional dedicated auxiliary, signal, communication or shield connection is documented for this exact insert. Conductive insert PE hardware is included only as the aggregate PE endpoint; hood/enclosure, coding elements and the mating insert are separate components. Installed hardware revision, connector mating compatibility and physical assembly bonding remain application checks.

connectionCoverage.notes: Manufacturer-numbered contacts 1-24 each have separate cable and female mating aliases (48 endpoints) and 24 explicit fixed paths. Verified PE contact assembly is represented by one aggregate PE endpoint; individual PE cable termination/mating/bond interfaces are not separately enumerated or linked. No hood or mating-half bonding is assumed.
